_comment: ICP-default preset (Ukrainian IT, remote). Copy to $YOKE_HOME/config/profile.json and edit. 'prompt' is fed to the model verbatim as the scoring profile — describe your lane, differentiators, seniority, languages, geo, comp floor. Be specific; vague profiles score everything mediocre. This default gets a new user to a scored board in one session without hand-editing (SC-001).
headline: Senior Software Engineer
prompt: Senior software engineer, Ukraine-based, working remotely. Target lane: Backend / Platform / Applied-AI engineer at product or AI-infra companies hiring remote in Europe or worldwide. Differentiators (count how many the role actually calls for, 0-5): Python, TypeScript, distributed/high-load systems, cloud (AWS/GCP), LLM/agent integration, eval/observability. Seniority: senior practitioner — NOT junior, NOT frontier research-scientist. Languages: English (professional), Ukrainian (native). Geo: fully remote; based in Ukraine; open to EU/EMEA/worldwide-remote; cannot relocate short-term. Comp: net monthly floor ~$3000.
